1. Authenticate the incoming client request using the bearer token header.
2. Validate the PDF file signature and ensure the file size is under ten megabytes.
3. Extract text content page by page using the PDF parser library.
4. Normalize whitespace while preserving essential structural boundaries.
5. Chunk text using the configured window size and overlap parameters.
6. Generate vector embeddings for all generated chunks concurrently.
7. Persist document metadata and chunk embeddings in an atomic transaction.
